card.fact_statement: The United Thai Nation Party was a member of the coalition government described as "waiting to collapse".
card.source_span: The United Thai Nation Party, another member of the coalition government, has been described by political observers as "waiting to collapse".

target_qa_variants.question: 2025年のタイ政治危機の際、連立政権内のどの政党が「崩壊を待っている」と評されましたか？
target_qa_variants.source_span: The United Thai Nation Party, another member of the coalition government, has been described by political observers as "waiting to collapse".
target_qa_variants.translation_note: United Thai Nation Party is commonly translated as タイ団結国家党 in Japanese media. The alias drops the word for 'Party' (党) to match the English alias.
